subject: general
question: Rengma is primarily a folk dance of ______.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Nagaland.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• **Rengma** is primarily a **folk dance of Nagaland.** The** singing, in harmony** and with echo effects is done by the dancers themselves while performing so energetically to** create a happy vibe.**
 
• The** major folk dances of Nagaland** include Modse, Agurshikukula, Butterfly Dance, Aaluyattu, Sadal Kekai, Changai Dance, Kuki Dance, Leshalaptu, Khamba Lim, Mayur Dance, Monyoasho, Rengma, Seecha and Kukui Kucho, Shankai and Moyashai etc.​

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
 

 **State**
 **Folk Dance**
 
 

 Rajasthan
 Bhavai, Chakri Dance, Chari Dance, Drum Dance, Fire Dance, Gair, Gawari, Ghoomar, etc.
 
 

 Bihar

 West Bengal
